notes: Source-only approved wording. Questions are not enrolled in the live approved-workflow registry, and this catalog conveys no notification or deployment authority.

footer.body:
If you have any questions or would like assistance with this request, our support team is happy to help. Simply reply to this message, email us at support@teamaot.com, or call us at 757-466-8862.

Please reference ticket {{ticket_number}} so we can assist you.

questions.title: Clarify the issue
questions.body: Could you provide a little more information about the issue you're experiencing?

questions.title: Describe the problem
questions.body: Could you describe what happens when you encounter the issue?

questions.title: Expected behavior
questions.body: What were you expecting to happen when the issue occurred?

questions.title: When it started
questions.body: Approximately when did you first notice this problem?

questions.title: Previous functionality
questions.body: Has this worked correctly in the past?

questions.title: Frequency
questions.body: Does this happen every time, or only occasionally?

questions.title: Reproduction steps
questions.body: Could you describe the steps you take before the issue occurs?

questions.title: Recent changes
questions.body: Were there any changes to your computer, software, or work environment shortly before this issue started?

questions.title: Number of users
questions.body: Is this affecting only you, or are other people experiencing the same issue?

questions.title: Number of devices
questions.body: Does this issue occur on more than one computer or device?

questions.title: Work interruption
questions.body: Is this issue preventing you from working, or are you able to continue using an alternative method?

questions.title: Business impact
questions.body: Could you let us know how this issue is affecting your work?

questions.title: Multiple locations
questions.body: Is this happening at just one location or at multiple locations?

questions.title: Consistent behavior
questions.body: Does the issue happen consistently, or does it come and go?

questions.title: Particular user
questions.body: Does the issue happen when someone else tries the same task?

questions.title: Priority clarification
questions.body: Is there a particular deadline or business requirement we should be aware of while addressing this issue?

questions.title: Exact error
questions.body: Are you receiving an error message? If so, could you provide the exact wording?

questions.title: Screenshot
questions.body: Could you send us a screenshot showing the issue? Please avoid including passwords or other sensitive information.

questions.title: Error code
questions.body: Does the message include an error number or code?

questions.title: Error timing
questions.body: At what point in the process does the error appear?

questions.title: Last occurrence
questions.body: Approximately what time did the issue last occur?

questions.title: Supporting details
questions.body: Is there any additional information displayed that might help us identify the problem?

questions.title: Changes in error
questions.body: Has the error message changed since the issue first appeared?

questions.title: Video evidence
questions.body: If the problem is difficult to describe, would you be able to provide a short screen recording showing what happens? Please avoid capturing confidential information.

questions.title: Device identification
questions.body: Which computer or device are you experiencing the issue on?

questions.title: Device availability
questions.body: Is the affected computer currently powered on and connected to the internet?

questions.title: Device location
questions.body: Where is the affected device located?

questions.title: Remote or office
questions.body: Are you working from the office, from home, or from another location?

questions.title: Device name
questions.body: Could you provide the computer name or the asset label on the affected device?

questions.title: Other devices
questions.body: Are you able to perform the same task successfully from another device?

questions.title: Device replacement
questions.body: Have you recently started using a different computer or had your current computer replaced?

questions.title: Device accessibility
questions.body: Are you currently able to sign in and use the affected computer?

questions.title: Affected account
questions.body: Which email address or username is associated with the issue? Please do not send your password.

questions.title: Sign-in error
questions.body: What message appears when you attempt to sign in?

questions.title: Account access elsewhere
questions.body: Are you able to sign in to the same account from another device?

questions.title: MFA notification
questions.body: Are you receiving the expected verification prompt when signing in?

questions.title: Unexpected MFA prompt
questions.body: Did you receive a verification request that you did not initiate? If so, please let us know whether you approved or denied it.

questions.title: Access previously worked
questions.body: Were you previously able to access this resource?

questions.title: Other users' access
questions.body: Can other authorized users access the same resource successfully?

questions.title: Permission requirement
questions.body: Could you explain what you need to access and what work you need to perform? This will help us determine the appropriate permissions.

questions.title: Sending or receiving
questions.body: Are you having difficulty sending messages, receiving messages, or both?

questions.title: Affected recipient
questions.body: Does the problem occur with every recipient or only particular addresses?

questions.title: Sender address
questions.body: Which email address was used to send the message?

questions.title: Message timing
questions.body: Approximately when was the affected message sent or expected to arrive?

questions.title: Delivery failure
questions.body: Did you receive a delivery failure or undeliverable message? If so, could you forward the failure notification to us?

questions.title: Attachment issue
questions.body: Does the problem occur only when sending or receiving attachments?

questions.title: Attachment size
questions.body: Approximately how large is the attachment you're trying to send?

questions.title: Email application
questions.body: Does the issue occur in your email application, webmail, or both?

questions.title: Shared resource
questions.body: Could you identify the file, folder, or shared resource you're trying to access?

questions.title: Access method
questions.body: Are you accessing the resource through a web browser, a desktop application, or a shared network location?

questions.title: File permissions
questions.body: Are you able to open the file but unable to make changes, or are you unable to open it at all?

questions.title: Shared link
questions.body: Does the issue occur when using a particular shared link?

questions.title: Collaboration scope
questions.body: Are other users having difficulty accessing or editing the same information?

questions.title: File location
questions.body: Do you know where the affected file or folder is normally stored?

questions.title: Sync issue
questions.body: Are changes failing to appear across devices, or are you receiving a synchronization error?

questions.title: Browser comparison
questions.body: Does the issue also occur when using a different web browser?

questions.title: Printer identification
questions.body: Which printer or copier is experiencing the issue?

questions.title: Printer location
questions.body: Where is the affected printer or copier located?

questions.title: Printing or scanning
questions.body: Is the issue related to printing, copying, scanning, or another function?

questions.title: Error message
questions.body: Is the printer or copier displaying an error message or code?

questions.title: Multiple users
questions.body: Are other users experiencing the same problem with this device?

questions.title: Print job scope
questions.body: Does the problem occur with every document or only particular files?

questions.title: Scan destination
questions.body: Where are you attempting to send the scanned document?

questions.title: Paper and supplies
questions.body: Is the device indicating that it needs paper, toner, or another supply?

questions.title: Connection type
questions.body: Are you connected through Wi-Fi or a wired network connection?

questions.title: Network scope
questions.body: Are other devices at your location experiencing the same connection issue?

questions.title: Website access
questions.body: Are you unable to access all websites, or only a particular website or service?

questions.title: Remote connection
questions.body: Does the problem occur only when working remotely?

questions.title: VPN status
questions.body: Are you receiving an error when attempting to establish your remote connection?

questions.title: Wireless network
questions.body: Which wireless network are you connected to?

questions.title: Telephone scope
questions.body: Is the telephone issue affecting one phone, several phones, or all phones at your location?

questions.title: Call behavior
questions.body: Is the issue occurring with incoming calls, outgoing calls, or both?

questions.title: Application name
questions.body: Which application are you having trouble with?

questions.title: Application function
questions.body: What were you attempting to do in the application when the problem occurred?

questions.title: Application access
questions.body: Does the application open successfully, or does the issue occur before it opens?

questions.title: Affected users
questions.body: Are other people able to use the same application successfully?

questions.title: Recent update
questions.body: Did the issue begin after an application update or configuration change?

questions.title: Specific file
questions.body: Does the problem occur with every file or only a particular file?

questions.title: Application performance
questions.body: Is the application slow, unresponsive, closing unexpectedly, or displaying an error?

questions.title: Software vendor
questions.body: Do you know whether the software vendor has already been contacted about this issue?

questions.title: Performance description
questions.body: Is your computer generally running slowly, or is the slowdown limited to a particular application?

questions.title: Timing of slowdown
questions.body: Does the performance issue occur throughout the day or only during particular activities?

questions.title: Storage warnings
questions.body: Have you received any messages indicating that your computer is running low on storage space?

questions.title: File storage
questions.body: Are there any large files or folders that you know must remain stored locally on this computer?

questions.title: Device behavior
questions.body: Is the computer freezing, restarting unexpectedly, shutting down, or showing another symptom?

questions.title: Hardware signs
questions.body: Have you noticed unusual noises, warning lights, or other physical signs of a problem?

questions.title: Connected devices
questions.body: Does the problem occur only when a particular accessory or external device is connected?

questions.title: Power issue
questions.body: Is the computer failing to power on, or does it power on but fail to start normally?

questions.title: Missing information
questions.body: Could you identify the file or information you need recovered?

questions.title: Last known availability
questions.body: When was the missing information last known to be available?

questions.title: Original location
questions.body: Where was the information originally stored?

questions.title: Deletion or modification
questions.body: Was the information deleted, overwritten, changed, or is it simply no longer visible?

questions.title: Recovery scope
questions.body: Are you looking to recover one file, a folder, or a larger collection of information?

questions.title: Recovery date
questions.body: Do you know approximately which date or version of the information you need restored?

questions.title: Other users' access
questions.body: Is anyone else still able to access the missing information?

questions.title: Recovery destination
questions.body: Would you prefer the recovered information to be placed in a separate location for review, if that option is available?

questions.title: Suspicious email
questions.body: Did you interact with any links or attachments in the suspicious message?

questions.title: Unrecognized activity
questions.body: Did you recognize the activity or sign-in attempt that was reported?

questions.title: Suspicious download
questions.body: Do you recognize the file or application referenced in the security alert?

questions.title: Expected software
questions.body: Is this software something you normally use for your work?

questions.title: Unexpected prompts
questions.body: Have you recently received unexpected requests to enter your password or approve a sign-in?

questions.title: Missing device
questions.body: Has the affected device been lost, stolen, or simply moved to another location?

questions.title: Security timeline
questions.body: Approximately when did you first notice the suspicious activity?

questions.title: Security observations
questions.body: Have you noticed any other unusual behavior that may be related to this concern?

questions.title: Availability
questions.body: What would be a convenient time for us to contact you about this issue?

questions.title: Remote assistance
questions.body: Would you be available to assist us with a remote troubleshooting session if needed?

questions.title: Access to device
questions.body: Is there someone available who can provide physical access to the affected device if necessary?

questions.title: Best contact
questions.body: Who would be the best person to contact for additional information about this issue?

questions.title: Maintenance scheduling
questions.body: Is there a preferred time when maintenance could be performed with minimal interruption to your work?

questions.title: Business hours
questions.body: Are there any business hours or scheduled activities we should avoid when planning additional work?

questions.title: Approval contact
questions.body: Who is authorized to approve changes that could affect this system or its users?

questions.title: Coordination
questions.body: Are there any other individuals or departments we should coordinate with before proceeding?

questions.title: Issue still occurring
questions.body: Are you still experiencing the issue?

questions.title: Retest
questions.body: When convenient, could you try the affected function again and let us know the result?

questions.title: Results after changes
questions.body: Have you noticed any improvement since the last troubleshooting steps were completed?

questions.title: Recurrence
questions.body: Has the problem returned since it last appeared to be resolved?

questions.title: Remaining symptoms
questions.body: Are you still experiencing any symptoms related to the original problem?

questions.title: Additional assistance
questions.body: Is there anything else related to this issue that you need assistance with?

questions.title: Resolution confirmation
questions.body: Does everything appear to be working correctly now?

questions.title: Ticket closure
questions.body: Based on your latest results, are you comfortable with us closing this support ticket?
